notes.text: Letter dated “Massy le 3.11.1970”, addressed “Cher Deligne”. It asks about Deligne’s reading of Rim’s SGA 7 VI, requests the text and comments, and asks whether and when he intends to read it if unfinished.
notes.basis: Scan 5 date, salutation and first paragraph; all three independent ink readings

notes.text: The writer says Mlle Altazin has typed Deligne’s SGA 4 XVIII and has been asked to send it with the manuscript for correction. He asks about receipt and the corrections, then requests the clean text. The page literally types “envoyes moi”, with final s and no hyphen; this confirms C’s prior question without modernizing the grammar.
notes.basis: Scan 5 second paragraph; all three readers identify the same final s and word space

notes.text: The final question asks for news of Ferrand about SGA 6 XI. The closing is “Bien cordialement”, with no visible signature. The archive numeral is 4. No mathematical proposition is tested on this correspondence page.
notes.basis: Scan 5 final question, closing and lower-left margin; all three independent readings

workflow_observation: The three readings are identical apart from trailing whitespace; no ink discrepancy and no crop. adjudication_note: Main comparison found only trailing-whitespace differences among the three complete readings. C and H agree with the ink on every textual locus reported by all readers. The earlier C envoyes moi question is resolved without changing C. No H collation rows.
